publicHealth.disabledRule: a disabled optional Phase 3 subsystem cannot degrade the established product health
publicHealth.enabledRule: an enabled subsystem with missing, unsafe or contradictory runtime telemetry degrades health
publicHealth.promotionRule: public health is runtime readiness only and never proves manual, review, beta or promotion evidence

window.captureFreshnessClock: client monotonic clock scoped to the authenticated connection generation
window.clientTimingClock: process monotonic clock archived by the manual campaign

featureState.e2eeMedia: deferred_unavailable and false until the deferred E2EE implementation exists
featureState.soundboard: count of canonical automation feature-state scopes
featureState.automation: count of canonical automation feature-state scopes
featureState.invalidCombination: automation enabled without soundboard is blocked and alerted

readiness.runtimeReady: all enabled runtime subsystems have present, safe and non-contradictory telemetry
readiness.promotionEvidenceReady: always false on this runtime view; the signed campaign manifest owns promotion evidence
readiness.provenanceReady: both non-empty build_version and one-way environment_ref_sha256 are present

privacy.environmentBinding: SHA-256 over a domain-separated deployment reference; the raw URL or host is not exported
privacy.contentRetention: the observability layer creates no audio, ciphertext, caption, transcript or filename rows
privacy.secretRule: keys, tokens, credential hashes and local paths are prohibited from health, operator JSON and archived evidence
privacy.hostileInputRule: untrusted identifiers, labels and arbitrary errors are never dimensions
